requirements.test_case: Determine the contour line and the 15° tangential points, then measure the radii in the 20 mm inward band with radius gauges or a 3D scan.

requirements.text: A rigid bumper surface on the outline contour line shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 2.5 mm in all other cases outside the 20 mm / 15° zone.
requirements.test_case: Measure the radii of the rigid bumper surface outside the defined zone (at least 2.5 mm).

requirements.text: Parts on or of the bumper, or bumper insets, which have a projection of less than 5 mm (e.g. joint covers, headlamp washer jets) are exempt from paragraph 6.5.2, but their outward-facing angles shall be blunted, except where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the projection of the bumper insets and inspect the outward-facing angles of those protruding 1.5 mm or more for blunting.

requirements.text: The bumper cover is not subject to paragraph 6.5.2, but it shall comply with the general provisions of paragraph 5 of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check the fascia radii and projections against the paragraph 5 general requirements by measurement.

requirements.text: Folds in the bumper fascia body panel may have a radius of curvature of less than 2.5 mm, provided that the radius is not less than one-tenth of the height H of the projection, measured according to Annex 3 paragraph 1.
requirements.test_case: Measure the fold radius and the projection height H per Annex 3 paragraph 1 and verify that the radius is at least H/10.

requirements.text: In case of movable air intake flaps or shutters in the bumper: the flaps shall meet the requirements of paragraphs 5.2, 5.3 and 5.4 in all positions of use.
requirements.test_case: Actuate the flaps through all positions of use and measure the projections and radii in each position.

requirements.text: In case of an integrated registration plate bracket: the supporting bracket shall comply with paragraph 5.4 if it is contactable by a 100 mm diameter sphere when a registration plate is fitted in accordance with the vehicle manufacturer's recommendation.
requirements.test_case: Fit a registration plate per the manufacturer's recommendation, probe with a 100 mm sphere and measure the radii of the contactable bracket areas.

requirements.text: In case the radar module is exposed in the fascia as an aerial: if the unattached end of the aerial is less than 2 m from the road surface in any position of use, the end shall be inside the zone bounded by the vertical planes 10 cm inside the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lateral position of the radar relative to the vehicle extreme outer edge (at least 10 cm inboard).

requirements.text: In case the radar module is exposed as an aerial: the radar shall be so fitted that no part of it protrudes beyond the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check by measurement that the radar and its housing lie within the vehicle's front and lateral extreme outer edge planes.

requirements.text: In case the radar module is exposed as an aerial with an unattached end: the unattached end shall be fitted with a fixed capping with radii of curvature not less than 2.5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the radii of the exposed radar housing end or capping with radius gauges.

requirements.text: In case the radar module is exposed as an aerial: the base of the aerial shall not project more than 40 mm when determined according to Annex 3 paragraph 2.
requirements.test_case: Measure the projection of the radar housing from the fascia per Annex 3 paragraph 2 (at most 40 mm).

requirements.text: In case the radar module is exposed and its base cannot be identified: under a horizontal force of not more than 50 daN in forward and rearward direction at its most salient part, the aerial shall either bend towards the support and not project more than 40 mm, or break off leaving no sharp or dangerous part contactable by a 100 mm sphere and no part projecting more than 40 mm.
requirements.test_case: Apply up to 50 daN forward and rearward with a ≤50 mm flat-ended ram, then measure the remaining projection and probe with a 100 mm sphere.

requirements.text: The vehicle (separate technical unit) approved under UN R26 shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraphs 5 and 6, including the bumper system's external-projection and radius requirements.
requirements.test_case: Take series-production bumper systems fitted to the vehicle and re-check projections, radii of curvature and gaps per paragraphs 5, 6 and Annex 3 against the approved type.

requirements.text: In case the bumper beam or a bracket is a partially visible sheet-metal component of the external surface: its sheet-metal edges shall not be permitted unless they are folded back (by approximately 180°, or towards the bodywork so that they cannot be contacted by a 100 mm diameter sphere) or are fitted with a shield meeting the requirements of this Regulation applicable to it.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the visible sheet-metal edges and check with a 100 mm sphere that each edge is folded back, not contactable, or shielded.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in Annex 3 (frontal longitudinal and corner impacts), the vehicle fitted with the front protective device shall meet the requirements of paragraphs 6.1.1 to 6.1.5.
requirements.test_case: Perform the Annex 3 longitudinal and corner impact tests on the front protective device, then inspect the vehicle against paragraphs 6.1.1 to 6.1.5.

requirements.text: After each impact test, the lighting and signalling devices shall continue to operate correctly.
requirements.test_case: After each impact, switch on all lighting and signalling functions and check that they operate correctly.

requirements.text: After each impact test, the lighting and signalling devices shall remain visible.
requirements.test_case: After each impact, visually inspect that no lamp is obscured by displaced bumper parts.

requirements.text: After each impact test, the vehicle's bonnet (hood), boot lid (trunk lid) and doors shall be operable in the normal manner.
requirements.test_case: After each impact, open and close the bonnet, boot lid and all doors by the normal means.

requirements.text: The side doors of the vehicle shall not be able to open under the effect of the impact.
requirements.test_case: Observe the impact on high-speed video and check after the test that no side door opened.

requirements.text: After each impact test, the vehicle's fuel and cooling systems shall have no leaks.
requirements.test_case: After each impact, inspect the fuel and cooling systems for fluid leaks.

requirements.text: After each impact test, the vehicle's fuel and cooling systems shall have no constricted fluid passages that prevent normal functioning.
requirements.test_case: After each impact, inspect hoses and radiator for constriction and check coolant flow and function.

requirements.text: After each impact test, the sealing devices and caps of the fuel and cooling systems shall be operable in the normal manner.
requirements.test_case: After each impact, open and close the fuel and coolant caps by hand.

requirements.text: After each impact test, the vehicle's exhaust system shall not suffer any damage or displacement that would prevent its normal function.
requirements.test_case: After each impact, inspect the exhaust system for damage or displacement and run the engine to confirm normal function.

requirements.text: After each impact test, the vehicle's propulsion, suspension (including tyres), steering and braking systems shall remain in adjustment.
requirements.test_case: After each impact, check wheel alignment and the adjustment of the steering and brakes against specification.

requirements.text: After each impact test, the vehicle's propulsion, suspension (including tyres), steering and braking systems shall operate in a normal manner.
requirements.test_case: After each impact, drive the vehicle and check propulsion, steering and braking function.

requirements.text: The driver-assist sensors, cameras and radar devices (e.g. the integrated radar module and front camera module) may become damaged, disoriented or broken by an Annex 3 impact, provided that the basic braking and steering performance of the vehicle remain intact.
requirements.test_case: After each impact, with the radar and camera possibly damaged or disconnected, verify that basic service braking and steering still work normally.

requirements.text: Every vehicle bearing the R42 approval mark shall conform to the approved vehicle type, particularly as regards features which influence the behaviour of the parts of the structure and the components affected by impact (front bumper fascia, energy absorber, pedestrian foam, bumper beam and mounting brackets).
requirements.test_case: Compare dimensions, materials and mounting of serially produced bumper system parts against the approved type documentation, and repeat the paragraph 6 impact checks if deviations are suspected.

requirements.text: The first contact of the impactor with the vehicle shall be by the impact contour on the front protective device.
requirements.test_case: During the longitudinal impact tests, check by high-speed video or contact marking that the impactor's impact contour first touches the bumper and no other front-end part.

requirements.text: In both the unladen weight and laden test weight conditions, the front protective device between the vehicle corners shall be intersected by the horizontal plane passing through the impactor reference line, the reference height being 445 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the vertical extent of the bumper above ground across its width between the 60° corner points, at unladen and laden test weight, and confirm it spans 445 mm.

requirements.text: The front protective device shall be impacted by an impactor whose effective mass equals the unladen weight of the vehicle to be tested.
requirements.test_case: Verify that the pendulum or moving-barrier effective mass equals the vehicle's unladen weight, and record the result in the test report.

requirements.text: The front surface of the vehicle shall be subjected to two longitudinal impacts, one with the vehicle at unladen weight and one with the vehicle at laden test weight.
requirements.test_case: Perform the two frontal longitudinal pendulum or barrier impacts at unladen weight and at laden test weight, then assess the vehicle against paragraph 6.

requirements.text: In the longitudinal impact test, the front of the vehicle shall be impacted at a speed of 4 km/h (+0.25/-0 km/h).
requirements.test_case: Record the impactor speed at impact with an instrument accurate to 1 % and confirm it is within 4.00–4.25 km/h.

requirements.text: The corner impact test shall consist of an impact at one front corner with the vehicle at unladen weight and an impact at the other front corner with the vehicle at laden test weight.
requirements.test_case: Perform the left and right front corner impacts at unladen weight and at laden test weight respectively, then assess the vehicle against paragraph 6.

requirements.text: In the corner impact test, plane A of the impactor shall make an angle of 60 ± 5° with the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the impactor plane A angle relative to the vehicle longitudinal median plane before the impact and confirm 55–65°.

requirements.text: In the corner impact test, the front corner of the vehicle shall be impacted at a speed of 2.5 km/h (+0.1/-0 km/h).
requirements.test_case: Record the impactor speed at impact with an instrument accurate to 1 % and confirm it is within 2.5–2.6 km/h.

requirements.text: Should the adjustment of the factory-fitted lighting devices be disturbed by the impact test, it shall be possible to correct it to conform to the required specifications by the normal means of adjustment only.
requirements.test_case: After each Annex 3 impact, measure headlamp aim and, if it is out of specification, check that it can be restored using only the normal adjusters.

requirements.text: In case the radar and/or camera module feeds a steering function (CSF, ACSF or ESF), the effectiveness of the steering equipment, including the electrical control lines and sensor inputs, shall not be adversely affected by magnetic or electric fields.
requirements.test_case: Run vehicle-level EMC immunity tests and confirm no steering malfunction or unintended intervention occurs.

requirements.text: Compliance shall be demonstrated by fulfilling the technical requirements of UN Regulation No. 10, 03 series of amendments, for vehicles without a coupling system for charging the traction battery, or 04 series of amendments, for vehicles with such a coupling system.
requirements.test_case: Review the UN R10 approval of the vehicle (and the ESAs) at the applicable series of amendments.

requirements.text: In case the camera/radar supports an advanced driver assistance steering system (CSF, ACSF or ESF), the function shall not cause any deterioration in the performance of the basic steering system.
requirements.test_case: Compare basic steering performance tests (para. 6.2) with the function active and inactive.

requirements.text: The advanced driver assistance steering system shall be designed such that the driver may, at any time and by deliberate action, override the function.
requirements.test_case: Apply a deliberate steering input during interventions and verify the function is overridden.

requirements.text: In case the lane-keeping function is a Corrective Steering Function (CSF), the CSF system, including its camera sensor, shall be subject to the requirements of Annex 6 (safety of complex electronic control systems).
requirements.test_case: Assess the Annex 6 documentation, safety concept and fault strategy, including camera failures.

requirements.text: In case of a CSF, every CSF intervention shall immediately be indicated to the driver by an optical warning signal displayed for at least 1 s or as long as the intervention exists, whichever is longer.
requirements.test_case: Trigger CSF interventions and measure the timing and duration of the optical signal.

requirements.text: When a flashing mode is used for the CSF optical warning signal, a lighting phase shall be visible at the end of the intervention or later.
requirements.test_case: Record the tell-tale state at the end of the intervention.

requirements.text: In case of a CSF based on the evaluation of lane markings or lane boundaries (camera-based), an acoustic warning signal shall be provided until the end of the intervention for any intervention longer than 10 s on an M1 vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Perform an Annex 8 CSF test with an intervention longer than 10 s and verify the acoustic signal lasts until the intervention ends.

requirements.text: In case of a lane-marking-based CSF, for two or more consecutive interventions within a rolling interval of 180 s without driver steering input, the system shall provide an acoustic warning signal during the second and any further intervention within that interval.
requirements.test_case: Provoke repeated interventions within 180 s without steering input and verify the acoustic signal from the second intervention onwards.

requirements.text: Starting with the third intervention within the rolling 180 s interval, the acoustic warning signal shall continue for at least 10 s longer than the previous warning signal.
requirements.test_case: Measure the acoustic warning durations for the 2nd, 3rd and 4th interventions.

requirements.text: In case of a CSF, the steering control effort necessary to override the directional control provided by the system shall not exceed 50 N in the whole range of CSF operations.
requirements.test_case: Measure the override force at the steering wheel rim during CSF interventions across the operating range.

requirements.text: The CSF requirements for warning signals and override effort, for a CSF reliant on lane markings or lane boundaries, shall be tested in accordance with the relevant vehicle tests of Annex 8.
requirements.test_case: Perform the Annex 8 CSF vehicle tests.

requirements.text: In case the radar/camera data are used for an Emergency Steering Function (ESF), the ESF system shall be subject to the requirements of Annex 6.
requirements.test_case: Assess the Annex 6 safety concept, including sensor failure and degradation.

requirements.text: In case of an ESF, the ESF shall only start an intervention where a risk of a collision is detected.
requirements.test_case: Drive scenarios with and without collision risk and verify interventions occur only with collision risk.

requirements.text: In case of an ESF, the vehicle shall be equipped with means to monitor the driving environment (e.g. lane markings, road edge, other road users) in line with the specified ESF use case.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the sensor set-up and verify detection of lane markings, road edges and road users relevant to the declared use cases.

requirements.text: The ESF environment-monitoring means shall monitor the driving environment at any time the ESF is active.
requirements.test_case: Log sensor status during ESF-active driving and verify continuous monitoring.

requirements.text: An automatic avoidance manoeuvre initiated by an ESF shall not lead the vehicle to leave the road, where applicable for the specified use case.
requirements.test_case: Perform the Annex 8 ESF tests and verify the vehicle stays on the road.

requirements.text: In case of an ESF intervention on a road or lane delimited with lane markings, the automatic avoidance manoeuvre shall not lead the vehicle to cross a lane marking, except steering back into the original lane when the intervention starts during a driver lane change or an unintentional drift.
requirements.test_case: Perform ESF tests on a marked lane and track the vehicle position relative to the lane markings.

requirements.text: In the absence of a lane marking on one or both sides, a single ESF intervention shall not produce a lateral offset greater than 0.75 m (measured at a fixed point on the vehicle front) towards the side without marking, unless the vehicle speed is below 20 km/h throughout and the system-generated lateral offset rate is limited to 2 m/s averaged over 1 s.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lateral offset with GNSS/IMU during ESF interventions on an unmarked road.

requirements.text: The ESF intervention shall not lead the vehicle to collide with another road user.
requirements.test_case: Review manufacturer evidence and run ESF scenario tests with targets in adjacent lanes.

requirements.text: Any ESF intervention shall be indicated to the driver with an optical and with an acoustic or haptic warning signal, provided at the latest at the start of the intervention and maintained as long as the intervention exists.
requirements.test_case: Trigger ESF interventions and record the signal timing against the intervention start and end.

requirements.text: An ESF system failure (e.g. radar/camera failure) shall be indicated to the driver with an optical warning signal, which may be suppressed when the system is manually deactivated.
requirements.test_case: Disconnect or blind the radar/camera and verify the optical failure warning.

requirements.text: In case of an ESF, the steering control effort necessary to override the directional control provided by the system shall not exceed 50 N.
requirements.test_case: Measure the steering wheel override force during ESF interventions.

requirements.text: A vehicle with ESF shall be tested in accordance with the relevant vehicle tests of Annex 8.
requirements.test_case: Perform the Annex 8 ESF tests.

requirements.text: In case the camera/radar provide or form part of the control transmission of a steering function (including advanced driver assistance steering systems), the requirements of Annex 6 shall be applied to the safety aspects of that electronic control system.
requirements.test_case: Perform the Annex 6 assessment of documentation, safety concept and fault simulation.

requirements.text: In case the front camera (and/or radar) provides input to a Corrective Steering Function, ACSF Category B1 or Emergency Steering Function, any fault of the camera/radar which impairs the steering function and is not mechanical in nature (e.g. sensor failure, blindness, misalignment) shall be signalled clearly to the driver of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inject camera/radar faults (disconnect, blind, misalign) on the vehicle and verify that a clear fault warning is shown to the driver.

requirements.text: In case the front camera (and/or radar) is part of an electronic system which has control over steering (CSF, ACSF B1 or ESF), it shall be possible to verify in a simple way the correct operational status of that electronic system, including its sensors.
requirements.test_case: Check that the operational status of the steering-related system, including camera/radar, can be verified simply (e.g. telltale bulb check or OBD/diagnostic readout) without disassembly.

requirements.text: In case the camera/radar-based function is an ACSF of any category, the ACSF shall fulfil the requirements of Annex 6 (safety concept, fault strategy, verification).
requirements.test_case: Audit the Annex 6 documentation and safety concept, then run the fault-injection verification tests.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category A using the front sensors, the system shall only operate up to 10 km/h (+2 km/h tolerance).
requirements.test_case: Drive the vehicle above 12 km/h with the system engaged and verify the system stops controlling the vehicle.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category A, the system shall be active only after a deliberate action of the driver and only if all associated functions (e.g. brakes, accelerator, steering, camera/radar/lidar) are working properly.
requirements.test_case: Inject a camera/radar fault and attempt activation; verify the system does not activate.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category A, the system shall be able to be deactivated by the driver at any time.
requirements.test_case: Deactivate the system during a manoeuvre and verify it terminates immediately.

requirements.text: In case the ACSF of Category A includes accelerator and/or braking control, the vehicle shall be equipped with a means to detect an obstacle (e.g. vehicle, pedestrian) in the manoeuvring area and to bring the vehicle immediately to a stop to avoid a collision.
requirements.test_case: Place an obstacle or pedestrian target in the manoeuvring path and verify the vehicle stops before contact.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category A, the system becoming operational shall be indicated to the driver.
requirements.test_case: Activate the system and inspect the driver indication.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category A, any termination of control shall produce a short but distinctive optical warning signal plus either an acoustic or a haptic warning signal (for RCP, at least an optical warning signal at the remote control device).
requirements.test_case: Terminate control during a manoeuvre and verify the optical and acoustic/haptic warnings are given.

requirements.text: In case of RCP, a direct influence on the steering angle via the remote-control device or by the movement of the driver shall not be possible.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to command steering via the remote device or by driver movement and verify the steering angle is not influenced.

requirements.text: In case of RCP, a direct influence on the vehicle speed via the remote device or driver movement shall only be possible in a way that the speed is reduced.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to increase speed via the remote device and verify only speed reduction is possible.

requirements.text: In case of RCP, the vehicle shall stop immediately if the continuous actuation (or the driver's continuous movement or detection) is interrupted or lost, if the specified maximum RCP operating range SRCPmax is exceeded, if the remote signal is lost, or if the driver's movement speed increases rapidly.
requirements.test_case: Interrupt actuation, exceed the range and jam the signal in turn, and verify an immediate stop each time.

requirements.text: In case of RCP, if a door or the trunk of the vehicle is opened during the parking manoeuvre, the vehicle shall stop immediately.
requirements.test_case: Open a door during the manoeuvre and verify the vehicle stops immediately.

requirements.text: In case of RCP, when the vehicle has reached its final parking position and the start/run switch is in the off position, the parking braking system shall be engaged automatically.
requirements.test_case: Complete a manoeuvre, switch off and verify the parking brake engages.

requirements.text: In case of RCP, whenever the vehicle becomes stationary during a parking manoeuvre, the RCP function shall prevent the vehicle from rolling away.
requirements.test_case: Stop the manoeuvre on a slope and verify the vehicle does not roll.

requirements.text: In case of RCP, the specified maximum RCP operating range shall not exceed 6 m.
requirements.test_case: Increase the remote-to-vehicle distance and verify the vehicle stops at or before 6 m.

requirements.text: In case of RCP, the system shall be designed to be protected against unauthorized activation or operation and against interventions into the system.
requirements.test_case: Review the security design and attempt unauthorized activation.

requirements.text: In case of RCP based on detection of driver position and movement, deactivation shall be possible through a simple and obvious action that is recognised by the system.
requirements.test_case: Perform the deactivation gesture/action and verify the system deactivates.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category B1, the activated system shall at any time, within the boundary conditions, ensure that the vehicle does not cross a lane marking for lateral accelerations below the manufacturer-specified maximum lateral acceleration aysmax.
requirements.test_case: Annex 8 lane-keeping test on curves up to aysmax; verify no lane-marking crossing.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category B1, the system shall not deactivate or unreasonably switch the control strategy in conditions where aysmax is not achievable (e.g. inclement weather, different tyres, laterally sloped roads).
requirements.test_case: Test on wet or sloped roads and verify the system stays active without unreasonable strategy changes.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category B1, the system lateral acceleration shall not exceed aysmax by more than 0.3 m/s² nor exceed the maximum in Table 1; for periods of no more than 2 s it shall not exceed aysmax by more than 40 per cent nor the Table 1 maximum by more than 0.3 m/s².
requirements.test_case: Measure lateral acceleration during the Annex 8 tests and compare with the limits.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category B1, the vehicle shall be equipped with a means for the driver to activate (standby mode) and deactivate (off mode) the system.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the HMI and operate the activation/deactivation control.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category B1, it shall be possible to deactivate the system at any time by a single action of the driver.
requirements.test_case: Deactivate the system with a single action while driving and verify off mode.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category B1, after deactivation the system shall only become active again as a result of a deliberate action by the driver.
requirements.test_case: After deactivation, verify the system does not reactivate without driver action.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category B1, the system shall be designed so that excessive steering intervention is suppressed to ensure the driver's steering operability and to avoid unexpected vehicle behaviour.
requirements.test_case: Assess via the override, lateral acceleration and jerk measurements below.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category B1, the steering control effort necessary to override the directional control provided by the system shall not exceed 50 N.
requirements.test_case: Measure the steering-wheel override force with a force-sensing steering wheel.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category B1, the specified maximum lateral acceleration aysmax shall be within the limits of Table 1: for M1 vehicles max 3 m/s² in all speed ranges, with minimum values of 0 m/s² (10–60 km/h), 0.5 m/s² (>60–100 km/h), 0.8 m/s² (>100–130 km/h) and 0.3 m/s² (>130 km/h).
requirements.test_case: Check the declared aysmax values against Table 1 and confirm them in Annex 8 tests.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category B1, the moving average over half a second of the lateral jerk generated by the system shall not exceed 5 m/s³.
requirements.test_case: Compute the 0.5 s moving average of lateral jerk from measured data during Annex 8 tests.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category B1, an optical signal shall be provided to the driver when the system is active.
requirements.test_case: Activate the system and inspect the active indication.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category B1, an optical signal shall be provided to the driver when the system is in standby mode.
requirements.test_case: Put the system in standby and inspect the indication.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category B1, when the system reaches its boundary conditions with no driver steering input and a front tyre starts to cross the lane marking, the system shall avoid sudden loss of steering support by continuing to provide assistance to the extent possible.
requirements.test_case: Drive a curve beyond aysmax hands-free and verify continued assistance.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category B1, in that boundary situation the system shall clearly inform the driver by an optical warning signal and additionally by an acoustic or haptic warning signal.
requirements.test_case: In the Annex 8 boundary test, verify the optical plus acoustic/haptic warning.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category B1, a system failure (e.g. camera failure) shall be signalled to the driver by an optical warning signal.
requirements.test_case: Disconnect or fault the camera and verify the optical failure warning.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category B1, when active between 10 km/h (or Vsmin, whichever is higher) and Vsmax, the system shall provide a means of detecting that the driver is holding the steering control.
requirements.test_case: Verify hands-on detection during driving tests.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category B1, if the driver is not holding the steering control after no longer than 15 s, an optical warning signal shall be provided. The signal shall show pictorial information of hands and the steering control.
requirements.test_case: Release the steering wheel and time the onset of the optical warning; inspect the pictogram.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category B1, if the driver is not holding the steering control after no longer than 30 s, at least the hands or steering control in the pictogram shall be shown in red and an acoustic warning signal shall be provided.
requirements.test_case: Continue hands-off and time the red pictogram and acoustic warning.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category B1, the hands-off warning signals shall stay active until the driver holds the steering control or the system is deactivated.
requirements.test_case: Verify the warnings persist until hands-on or deactivation.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category B1, the system shall be deactivated automatically at the latest 30 s after the acoustic warning signal has started.
requirements.test_case: Time the automatic deactivation after the acoustic warning starts.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category B1, after automatic deactivation the system shall inform the driver by an acoustic emergency signal, different from the previous acoustic warning, for at least 5 s or until the driver holds the steering control again.
requirements.test_case: Record the emergency signal after deactivation and check its duration and that it differs from the earlier warning.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category B1, the optical signals of paragraph 5.6.2.2 shall all be different from each other (e.g. symbol, colour, blinking, text), unless otherwise specified.
requirements.test_case: Inspect and compare all B1 optical signals.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, the vehicle shall also be equipped with a complying ACSF of Category B1.
requirements.test_case: Verify the B1 system is present and approved.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C in standby mode, the ACSF of Category B1 shall aim to centre the vehicle in the lane unless a different position is reasonable due to the situation or driver input.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lateral position in lane during standby driving.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, the default status of the system shall be off mode at each initiation of the powertrain.
requirements.test_case: Restart the powertrain and verify off mode.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, the vehicle shall be equipped with a means for the driver to activate (standby) and deactivate (off) the system.
requirements.test_case: Inspect and operate the control.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, the system shall only be activated (standby) after a deliberate action by the driver.
requirements.test_case: Verify no activation without driver action.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, activation shall only be possible on roads where pedestrians and cyclists are prohibited, with physical separation of opposing traffic and at least two lanes in the driving direction, ensured by at least two independent means.
requirements.test_case: Attempt activation on non-qualifying roads and review the independent road-type detection means.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, on transition to a road type where Category C is not permitted, the system shall deactivate automatically (off mode), unless the only unmet condition is a missing second lane.
requirements.test_case: Drive from a motorway onto a non-qualifying road and verify automatic deactivation.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, it shall be possible to deactivate the system at any time by a single driver action. Afterwards it shall only be reactivated by a deliberate driver action.
requirements.test_case: Deactivate with a single action and verify no automatic reactivation.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, it shall be possible to perform the Annex 8 tests on a test track.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the system can be operated on the test track for the Annex 8 tests.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, a steering input by the driver shall override the steering action of the system.
requirements.test_case: Apply a steering input during a lane change and verify the driver has priority.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, the steering effort needed to override the system shall not exceed 50 N.
requirements.test_case: Measure the override force with a force-sensing steering wheel.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, the system-induced lateral acceleration during a lane change shall not exceed 1 m/s² in addition to that from lane curvature.
requirements.test_case: Measure lateral acceleration during Annex 8 lane-change tests.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, the lane change shall not cause total vehicle lateral acceleration to exceed the Table 1 maxima (3 m/s² for M1).
requirements.test_case: Measure total lateral acceleration during lane change.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, the 0.5 s moving average of system-generated lateral jerk shall not exceed 5 m/s³.
requirements.test_case: Compute the jerk moving average from measured data.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, the optical signals of paragraph 5.6.4.5 shall be easily distinguishable from each other.
requirements.test_case: Inspect all Category C optical signals.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, an optical signal shall be provided when the system is in standby mode.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the standby indication.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, an automatic change into standby mode shall be indicated prominently and understandably, differently from the standby signal itself (unless an off-mode indication is displayed after activation).
requirements.test_case: Trigger an automatic standby transition and inspect the indication.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, an optical signal shall be provided to the driver while the lane change procedure is ongoing.
requirements.test_case: Initiate a lane change and inspect the signal.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, when the lane change procedure is suppressed by the system, the driver shall be informed by an optical warning plus an acoustic or haptic warning (optical only if the driver initiated the suppression).
requirements.test_case: Trigger a system suppression and verify the warnings.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, a system failure shall be signalled immediately by an optical warning signal; a failure during a lane change manoeuvre shall be signalled by an optical and an acoustic or haptic warning.
requirements.test_case: Inject a sensor fault before and during a lane change and verify the warnings.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, if the driver is not holding the steering control within no longer than 3 s after lane change procedure initiation and before the manoeuvre starts, the B1 hands-on optical warning shall be provided until hands-on or deactivation.
requirements.test_case: Initiate a lane change hands-off and time the warning.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, initiating a lane change procedure shall only be possible if the ACSF of Category B1 is already active.
requirements.test_case: Attempt initiation with B1 inactive and verify it is rejected.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, the lane change procedure shall require, and start immediately after, the driver's manual activation of the direction indicator to the intended side.
requirements.test_case: Activate the indicator and verify the procedure starts immediately.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, when the lane change procedure starts, B1 shall be suspended and Category C shall carry on lane keeping until the manoeuvre starts.
requirements.test_case: Monitor lane keeping between procedure start and manoeuvre start.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, the lateral movement towards the intended lane shall not start earlier than 1.0 s after the lane change procedure starts.
requirements.test_case: Time the onset of lateral movement from indicator activation.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, the lateral movement to approach the marking and complete the lane change shall be one continuous movement.
requirements.test_case: Analyse the lateral position trace for continuity.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, the vehicle shall not be equipped with both automatic and second-deliberate-action initiation of the lane change manoeuvre.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the system design and HMI.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C with automatic initiation, the lane change manoeuvre shall commence between 3.0 s and 5.0 s after manual activation of the procedure.
requirements.test_case: Time manoeuvre commencement from indicator activation.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C with initiation by a second deliberate action, the manoeuvre shall commence between 3.0 s and 7.0 s after manual activation and at the latest 3.0 s after the second action.
requirements.test_case: Time manoeuvre commencement relative to both driver actions.

requirements.text: In case of initiation by a second deliberate action, the control for the second action shall be located in the steering control area.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the control location.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C on an M1 vehicle, the lane change manoeuvre shall be completed in less than 5 s.
requirements.test_case: Measure the manoeuvre duration in Annex 8 tests.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, B1 lane keeping shall resume automatically once the lane change manoeuvre has completed.
requirements.test_case: Verify B1 is active after the manoeuvre.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, the direction indicator shall remain active throughout the lane change manoeuvre.
requirements.test_case: Record indicator status during the manoeuvre.

requirements.text: In case of automatic initiation with the indicator control not latched, the system shall deactivate the direction indicator no later than 0.5 s after B1 resumes.
requirements.test_case: Time indicator deactivation after B1 resumption.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, the lane change procedure shall be suppressed automatically before the manoeuvre starts if a critical situation per 5.6.4.7 is detected, the system is overridden or switched off, its boundaries are reached (e.g. lane markings not detected), the driver is not holding the steering control, the indicator is manually cancelled, the manoeuvre has not commenced within the 5.0 s/7.0 s/3.0 s limits, the second action is not detected within 5.0 s, or the lateral movement is not continuous.
requirements.test_case: Test each suppression condition, including an approaching vehicle at critical distance, and verify suppression.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, the driver shall be able to cancel the lane change procedure manually at any time using the direction indicator control.
requirements.test_case: Cancel the indicator during the procedure and verify cancellation.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, the system shall detect vehicles approaching from the rear in an adjacent lane up to the declared distance Srear, which shall not be less than 55 m.
requirements.test_case: Annex 8 test with an approaching L3 motorcycle and verify detection at Srear ≥ 55 m.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, lane change manoeuvres shall only be performed at or above Vsmin calculated from Srear, unless another vehicle is detected within Srear, the situation is not critical and Srear exceeds Scritical.
requirements.test_case: Attempt lane changes below the calculated Vsmin and verify inhibition except in the permitted conditions.

requirements.text: In case a national speed limit below 130 km/h is used for Vapp, the vehicle shall be equipped with a means to detect the country of operation and shall have that country's general maximum speed limit available.
requirements.test_case: Verify country detection and the speed-limit data.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, the system detection area at ground level shall be at least as shown in the figure of 5.6.4.8.2.
requirements.test_case: Map the sensor detection area at ground level and compare with the figure.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, after each powertrain initiation lane change manoeuvres shall be prevented until the system has detected, at least once, a moving object beyond Srear.
requirements.test_case: Restart and attempt a lane change before and after detecting a distant moving object.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, the system shall be able to detect sensor blindness (e.g. dirt, ice, snow).
requirements.test_case: Cover or soil the sensors and verify blindness is detected.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, upon detection of sensor blindness, the lane change manoeuvre shall be prevented.
requirements.test_case: With a blinded sensor, attempt a lane change and verify it is prevented.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C with sensor blindness, the system status shall be signalled to the driver no later than initiation of the lane change procedure.
requirements.test_case: Verify the warning appears at the latest on procedure initiation.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, the sensor range shall be specified so that sensor deterioration over lifetime does not affect fulfilment of paragraphs 5.6.4.8.3 and 5.6.4.8.4.
requirements.test_case: Review sensor range ageing data and test the aged sensor range against Srear.

requirements.text: The camera/radar-based functions shall not exhibit ACSF Category B2, D or E functionality unless they are incorporated in a DCAS that allows their activation only as part of DCAS and complies with UN R171.
requirements.test_case: Review the function specification to confirm no B2/D/E functionality outside an R171-compliant DCAS.

requirements.text: In case the front radar and/or camera module serve as sensors of a Remote Control Manoeuvring (RCM) function on an M1 vehicle, the RCM shall be subject to the requirements of Annex 6.
requirements.test_case: Review the Annex 6 safety-concept documentation and verification for the RCM, including the sensor elements.

requirements.text: In case the front radar and/or camera module serve an RCM function, the RCM function shall be active only after a deliberate action of the driver and only if the conditions for operation are fulfilled, including the camera/radar working properly.
requirements.test_case: Disable or blind the radar/camera and verify that the RCM function cannot be activated.

requirements.text: In case the front radar and/or camera module provide the RCM obstacle detection, the vehicle shall be equipped with a means to detect an obstacle (e.g. vehicles, pedestrians) in the manoeuvring area and to bring the vehicle immediately to a stop to avoid a collision.
requirements.test_case: Place vehicle and pedestrian targets in the manoeuvring area during RCM and verify detection and an immediate stop without collision.

requirements.text: In case the front sensors provide RCM obstacle detection, after the vehicle stops on detecting an obstacle in the manoeuvring area, subsequent operation shall only be possible following confirmation from the driver.
requirements.test_case: After an obstacle-triggered stop, verify that the manoeuvre cannot resume without driver confirmation on the remote device.

requirements.text: In case the front sensors provide RCM obstacle detection, the vehicle shall respond to any subsequent objects detected in the manoeuvring area by stopping immediately to avoid a collision, as prescribed in paragraph 5.7.1.14.
requirements.test_case: Introduce a second obstacle after resumption and verify that the vehicle stops immediately again.

requirements.text: In case the camera and/or radar module form part of 'The System' (CSF, ACSF Category B1 or ESF), 'The System' shall respect, under non-fault and fault conditions, all the appropriate performance requirements specified elsewhere in UN R79.
requirements.test_case: Run the Annex 8 performance tests with and without injected sensor faults and compare the results with the R79 limits.

requirements.text: In case the camera and/or radar module form part of 'The System', 'The System' shall be designed to operate in such a way that it does not induce safety critical risks.
requirements.test_case: Review the hazard/risk analysis and run fault-injection vehicle tests on the sensor units.

requirements.text: Any enabled or disabled safety-related driver-assistance steering function (CSF, ACSF, ESF) whose hardware and software (including the camera/radar sensing) are present in the vehicle at production shall be declared and shall meet the requirements of Annex 6 before it is used in the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Compare the function list declared to the Technical Service against the sensor software capabilities and calibration flags.

requirements.text: In case the camera/radar module is a unit of 'The System', each unit shall be clearly and unambiguously identifiable, by marking for the hardware and by marking or software output for the software content.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the module label and read the software version via diagnostics.

requirements.text: Where functions are combined within a single unit (e.g. camera module with integrated image processing), only a single hardware identification marking shall be used.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the module for a single hardware identification marking.

requirements.text: The unit identification shall define the hardware and software version and shall be changed when a software change alters the function of the unit as far as UN R79 is concerned.
requirements.test_case: Review the change management records and check that the identification changed with each function-relevant software release.

requirements.text: In case of a failure of 'The System' (including the camera/radar sensing units), the driver shall be warned, for example by a warning signal or message display.
requirements.test_case: Inject sensor faults (disconnect, blockage, misalignment) and verify that the driver warning is given.

requirements.text: When 'The System' is not deactivated by the driver, the failure warning shall be present as long as the fault condition persists.
requirements.test_case: Hold an injected sensor fault and verify that the warning remains on until the fault is cleared or the system is deactivated.

requirements.text: If 'The System' selects removal of the Higher Level Function on failure, all output control signals associated with that function shall be inhibited in such a manner as to limit the transition disturbance.
requirements.test_case: Inject a sensor fault during active steering intervention and measure the steering torque/angle transient at switch-off.

requirements.text: For ADSS functions, the safety approach at concept level shall consider situations where a system free from faults may create safety critical risks (e.g. due to a lack of or wrong comprehension of the vehicle environment by the sensors), reasonably foreseeable misuse by the driver and intentional modification of the system, based on a hazard/risk analysis.
requirements.test_case: Review the hazard/risk analysis and validation (HIL/on-road) results for sensor perception limitations.

requirements.text: Measures shall be in place to ensure that 'The System' does not prejudice the safe operation of the vehicle when its performance is affected by environmental conditions, e.g. climatic, temperature, dust ingress, water ingress, ice packing (e.g. sensor blockage behind the bumper fascia).
requirements.test_case: Run climatic, spray, dirt and ice blockage tests on the sensors mounted in the bumper and verify that degradation is detected and the system reacts safely.

requirements.text: Under non-fault conditions, the behaviour of 'The System' shall correspond with the manufacturer's description of its functions, including the control strategies and override scenarios.
requirements.test_case: Run selected functional tests, including override scenarios, and compare the results with the function description.

requirements.text: The reaction of 'The System' to a simulated failure in any individual unit (e.g. the camera or radar module) shall correspond with the documented failure analysis, such that the safety concept and execution are confirmed as adequate.
requirements.test_case: Simulate a failure of the camera or radar unit and compare the vehicle reaction and HMI with the FMEA/FTA summary.

requirements.text: In case the front camera (and/or radar) is a sensor of a CSF or ACSF, the vehicle fitted with the CSF and/or ACSF shall fulfil the appropriate test requirements of Annex 8.
requirements.test_case: Run the Annex 8 test programme for each declared CSF/ACSF/ESF category on the vehicle with the bumper sensors fitted.

requirements.text: The CSF/ACSF performance requirements shall be met on a flat, dry asphalt or concrete surface affording good adhesion, at an ambient temperature between 0 °C and 45 °C.
requirements.test_case: Perform the Annex 8 tests on a dry high-adhesion track at temperatures across 0–45 °C and record the results.

requirements.text: The lane-marking-based CSF/ACSF shall function correctly with all lane markings identified in Annex 3 of UN Regulation No. 130 (00 series), demonstrated by documentation for markings not physically tested.
requirements.test_case: Test on one R130 Annex 3 marking layout and review camera detection documentation for all other layouts.

requirements.text: The CSF/ACSF shall work at all vehicle load conditions.
requirements.test_case: Review documentation and spot-test the system at unladen and maximum-load conditions.

requirements.text: In case of a CSF covered by paragraph 5.1.6.1.2.1 on an M1 vehicle, the acoustic or haptic warning shall be provided no later than 10 s after the beginning of a CSF intervention that is maintained for longer than 10 s.
requirements.test_case: Drive with activated CSF so that the vehicle keeps attempting to leave the lane for more than 10 s and record the warning onset time.

requirements.text: In case of a CSF covered by paragraph 5.1.6.1.2.2, an optical warning signal shall be provided for each intervention for as long as the intervention exists.
requirements.test_case: Provoke at least three interventions within 180 s and record the optical signal against each intervention's duration.

requirements.text: In case of a CSF covered by paragraph 5.1.6.1.2.2, an acoustic or haptic warning signal shall be provided at the second and third intervention within a rolling interval of 180 s.
requirements.test_case: Provoke three interventions within 180 s and record the acoustic/haptic signals.

requirements.text: In case of a CSF covered by paragraph 5.1.6.1.2.2, the acoustic or haptic warning signal at the third intervention shall be at least 10 s longer than the one at the second intervention.
requirements.test_case: Compare the recorded durations of the second and third acoustic/haptic warnings.

requirements.text: In case of a CSF, the requirements of paragraphs 5.1.6.1.1 and 5.1.6.1.2 shall be fulfilled in the whole range of CSF operation.
requirements.test_case: Review the manufacturer's documentation covering the full CSF operating range.

requirements.text: In case of a CSF, the force applied by the driver on the steering control to override a CSF intervention shall not exceed 50 N.
requirements.test_case: Provoke a CSF intervention and measure the driver override force at the steering control.

requirements.text: In case of a CSF, the requirements of paragraph 5.1.6.1.3 shall be fulfilled in the whole range of CSF operation.
requirements.test_case: Review the override-force documentation over the full CSF operating range.

requirements.text: In case of ACSF Category B1, when the vehicle is driven hands-off between Vsmin and Vsmax on a curved track requiring 80–90 % of aysmax, no outside edge of the tyre tread of the vehicle's front wheel shall cross the outside edge of any lane marking.
requirements.test_case: Perform the lane keeping functional test for each speed range and check front-wheel position relative to the lane marking.

requirements.text: In case of ACSF Category B1, during the lane keeping functional test the moving average over half a second of the lateral jerk shall not exceed 5 m/s³.
requirements.test_case: Record lateral acceleration at 100 Hz or more, filter it, and evaluate the 0.5 s moving average of the jerk.

requirements.text: In case of ACSF Category B1, the lane keeping requirements shall be fulfilled for the whole lateral acceleration and speed range.
requirements.test_case: Review the manufacturer's documentation over the full speed and lateral acceleration range.

requirements.text: In case of ACSF Category B1, when a curve and speed provoking more than aysmax + 0.3 m/s² are driven hands-off, the recorded lateral acceleration shall be within the limits of paragraph 5.6.2.1.1.
requirements.test_case: Perform the maximum lateral acceleration test with any embedded speed control inhibited and compare the recorded acceleration against the 5.6.2.1.1 limits.

requirements.text: In case of ACSF Category B1, during the maximum lateral acceleration test the moving average over half a second of the lateral jerk shall not exceed 5 m/s³.
requirements.test_case: Evaluate the 0.5 s moving-average jerk from the recorded lateral acceleration.

requirements.text: In case of ACSF Category B1, the force applied by the driver on the steering control to override the system and leave the lane shall be less than 50 N.
requirements.test_case: Drive a curve at 80–90 % of aysmax, override the system to leave the lane, and measure the steering force.

requirements.text: In case of ACSF Category B1, the override force condition (less than 50 N) shall be fulfilled throughout the ACSF operation range.
requirements.test_case: Review documentation of override force over the full operating range.

requirements.text: In case of ACSF Category B1, after the driver releases the steering control, the optical warning signal shall be given at the latest 15 s after release and shall remain until the ACSF is deactivated, in both the low-speed and the high-speed tests.
requirements.test_case: Perform the hands-on transition test at Vsmin+10–20 km/h and at Vsmax−20–10 km/h (max 130 km/h) and record the warning timing.

requirements.text: In case of ACSF Category B1, during the lower speed test the acoustic warning signal shall be given at the latest 30 s after the steering control has been released and shall remain until the ACSF is deactivated.
requirements.test_case: Record the onset and duration of the acoustic warning in the low-speed hands-off test.

requirements.text: In case of ACSF Category B1, during the lower speed test the ACSF shall be deactivated at the latest 30 s after the acoustic warning signal has started, with an acoustic emergency signal of at least 5 s that differs from the previous acoustic warning signal.
requirements.test_case: Record the deactivation time and the duration and character of the emergency signal in the low-speed hands-off test.

requirements.text: In case of ACSF Category B1 on an M1 vehicle, when a curve requiring aysmax + 0.1 to aysmax + 0.4 m/s² provokes a lane crossing, the optical warning signal and additionally an acoustic or haptic warning signal shall be given at the latest when the outside edge of the front wheel tyre tread has crossed the outside edge of the lane marking.
requirements.test_case: Perform the lane crossing warning test and compare the warning timing with the wheel crossing position.

requirements.text: In case of ACSF Category B1, during the lane crossing test the system shall continue to provide assistance as required in paragraph 5.6.2.2.3.
requirements.test_case: Verify from the recorded data that steering assistance continues during and after the lane crossing.

requirements.text: In case the radar/camera feed an Emergency Steering Function, the requirements of paragraphs 5.1.6.2.1 to 5.1.6.2.6 shall be fulfilled in the whole range of ESF operation specified by the vehicle manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Review ESF documentation and the agreed use-case tests.

requirements.text: In case of ESF Type a i/ii, when a target vehicle in the adjacent lane minimises the lateral separation, the warnings of paragraph 5.1.6.2.6 shall be provided no later than the start of the ESF intervention.
requirements.test_case: Perform the unintentional lateral manoeuvre test and record warning timing against intervention start.

requirements.text: In case of ESF Type a i/ii, the ESF intervention shall not lead the vehicle to leave its original lane.
requirements.test_case: Track the vehicle's lateral position during the intervention relative to the lane markings.

requirements.text: In case of ESF Type a iii, when the vehicle starts a lane change while another vehicle drives in the adjacent lane such that a collision would occur, an ESF intervention shall be started.
requirements.test_case: Perform the intentional lateral manoeuvre test and verify that the intervention starts.

requirements.text: In case of ESF Type a iii, the warnings of paragraph 5.1.6.2.6 shall be provided no later than the start of the ESF intervention.
requirements.test_case: Record warning timing against intervention start.

requirements.text: In case of ESF Type a iii, the ESF intervention shall not lead the vehicle to leave its original lane.
requirements.test_case: Track the lateral position relative to the original lane.

requirements.text: In case of ESF Type b, when approaching an object in the vehicle's trajectory that can be passed without crossing the lane markings, the ESF intervention shall avoid or mitigate the collision.
requirements.test_case: Approach a target object within the lane and evaluate collision avoidance or impact speed reduction.

requirements.text: In case of ESF Type b, the warnings of paragraph 5.1.6.2.6 shall be provided no later than the start of the ESF intervention.
requirements.test_case: Record warning timing against intervention start.

requirements.text: In case of ESF Type b, the ESF intervention shall not lead the vehicle to leave its lane.
requirements.test_case: Track the lateral position relative to the lane markings.

requirements.text: In case the ESF works in the absence of lane markings, on a track without lane markings an ESF intervention shall be started and the warnings of paragraph 5.1.6.2.6 shall be provided no later than the start of the intervention.
requirements.test_case: Repeat the ESF tests on an unmarked track and record intervention and warning timing.

requirements.text: In case the ESF works in the absence of lane markings, the lateral offset during the manoeuvre shall be at most 0.75 m; if this is exceeded in an intervention below 20 km/h, the lateral offset rate shall not exceed 2 m/s.
requirements.test_case: Measure lateral offset and offset rate during the unmarked-track ESF manoeuvre.

requirements.text: In case the ESF works in the absence of lane markings, the vehicle shall not leave the road due to the ESF intervention, where applicable for the specified use case.
requirements.test_case: Check the vehicle path relative to the road edge during the test.

requirements.text: In case of ESF Type b, the ESF shall not start any intervention when approaching a plastic sheet (thickness under 3 mm, 0.8 m x 2 m, contrasting colour) lying between the lane markings in the vehicle's trajectory.
requirements.test_case: Drive over the specified plastic sheet with ESF active and verify that no intervention occurs.

requirements.text: In case the front sensors contribute to ACSF Category C, in the lane change functional test the lateral movement towards the marking shall not start earlier than 1 s after the lane change procedure is initiated.
requirements.test_case: Perform the lane change functional test at Vsmin+10 km/h in both directions and record the timing.

requirements.text: In case of ACSF Category C, the lateral movement to approach the lane marking and the movement to complete the lane change shall be one continuous movement.
requirements.test_case: Analyse the lateral position trace of the lane change manoeuvre.

requirements.text: In case of ACSF Category C, the recorded lateral acceleration during the lane change shall not exceed 1 m/s².
requirements.test_case: Evaluate the filtered lateral acceleration during the lane change.

requirements.text: In case of ACSF Category C, the moving average over half a second of the lateral jerk during the lane change shall not exceed 5 m/s³.
requirements.test_case: Evaluate the 0.5 s moving-average jerk during the lane change.

requirements.text: In case of ACSF Category C, the time between the start of the lane change procedure and the start of the lane change manoeuvre shall be not less than 3.0 s and not more than 5.0 s for automatic initiation, or 7.0 s for initiation by a second deliberate action.
requirements.test_case: Measure the procedure-to-manoeuvre time in the functional test.

requirements.text: In case of ACSF Category C initiated by a second deliberate action, that action shall occur no more than 5.0 s after the start of the lane change procedure, and the manoeuvre shall start no more than 3.0 s after the second deliberate action.
requirements.test_case: Measure the time intervals between procedure start, second action and manoeuvre start.

requirements.text: In case of ACSF Category C, the system shall inform the driver that the lane change procedure is ongoing.
requirements.test_case: Observe the driver information during the lane change procedure.

requirements.text: In case of ACSF Category C on an M1 vehicle, the lane change manoeuvre shall be completed in less than 5 s.
requirements.test_case: Measure the manoeuvre duration.

requirements.text: In case of ACSF Category C, ACSF Category B1 shall automatically resume after the lane change procedure is completed.
requirements.test_case: Verify B1 status after completion of the lane change.

requirements.text: In case of ACSF Category C with automatically initiated lateral movement and a direction indicator control that was not latched, the direction indicator shall be deactivated not before the end of the lane change manoeuvre and no later than 0.5 s after ACSF B1 has resumed.
requirements.test_case: Record the direction indicator signal timing relative to manoeuvre end and B1 resumption.

requirements.text: In case of ACSF Category C, the lane change manoeuvre shall not be performed at a vehicle speed of Vsmin − 10 km/h.
requirements.test_case: Initiate a lane change procedure at Vsmin − 10 km/h and verify that no manoeuvre is performed.

requirements.text: In case Vsmin of ACSF Category C is based on a country-specific general speed limit below 130 km/h, the lane change manoeuvre shall be performed at Vsmin + 10 km/h and shall not be performed at Vsmin − 10 km/h.
requirements.test_case: Run the lane change tests at Vsmin ± 10 km/h in the simulated country of operation.

requirements.text: In case Vsmin of ACSF Category C is based on a country-specific speed limit, the vehicle shall be able to detect the country of operation and shall know that country's general maximum speed limit.
requirements.test_case: Review the manufacturer's demonstration of country detection and stored speed limits.

requirements.text: In case of ACSF Category C, the measured force to override a lane change manoeuvre shall not exceed 50 N.
requirements.test_case: Hold the steering straight during an initiated lane change in both directions and measure the force.

requirements.text: In case of ACSF Category C, the lane change procedure shall be suppressed if, before the manoeuvre starts, the system is overridden, switched off, the speed drops to Vsmin − 10 km/h, the hands-off warning is initiated, the direction indicator is manually deactivated, the manoeuvre has not commenced within 5.0 s (7.0 s for second deliberate action), or the second deliberate action is later than 5.0 s.
requirements.test_case: Repeat the lane change procedure for each listed condition and verify that it is suppressed.

requirements.text: In case of ACSF Category C, the system shall detect a motorcycle approaching from the rear in the adjacent lane at 120 km/h no later than at the manufacturer-declared distance Srear.
requirements.test_case: Perform the sensor performance test with an L3 motorcycle and DGPS distance measurement.

requirements.text: In case of ACSF Category C, when the rear sensor(s) are blinded, the system shall detect the sensor blindness, warn the driver as defined in paragraph 5.6.4.8.4, and be prevented from performing the lane change manoeuvre.
requirements.test_case: Blind the sensor(s), initiate a lane change at Vsmin+10 km/h, and verify detection, warning and inhibition.

requirements.text: In case of ACSF Category C, following a new initiation of the powertrain with the ACSF not activated, the lane change manoeuvre shall not be initiated.
requirements.test_case: Perform phase 1 of the powertrain initiation test.

requirements.text: In case of ACSF Category C, after a new powertrain initiation the lane change manoeuvre shall not start while the system has not yet detected a moving object at a distance equal to or greater than Srear.
requirements.test_case: Perform phase 2 of the powertrain initiation test.

requirements.text: In case of ACSF Category C, after an approaching vehicle has been detected no later than at distance Srear, the lane change manoeuvre shall be executed.
requirements.test_case: Perform phase 3 with an approaching series vehicle and record the detection distance and manoeuvre execution.

requirements.text: In case a fault of the front camera and/or radar feeding a steering function (CSF, ACSF B1 or ESF) is signalled by an optical warning signal, the optical warning signal shall be visible, even by daylight.
requirements.test_case: Induce a sensor fault on the vehicle and check under daylight conditions that the telltale is clearly visible from the driver's seat.

requirements.text: In case a fault of the front camera and/or radar feeding a steering function is signalled optically, the optical warning signal shall be distinguishable from other alerts.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the instrument cluster to confirm the steering-fault telltale differs in symbol or colour from other alerts.

requirements.text: The satisfactory condition of the optical warning signals shall be easily verifiable by the driver from the driver's seat.
requirements.test_case: At ignition on, check from the driver's seat that the telltale bulb-check illumination is visible.

requirements.text: The failure of a component of the warning devices shall not entail any loss of the steering system's performance.
requirements.test_case: Disconnect or fail the warning telltale and verify that steering performance is unchanged.

requirements.text: In case acoustic warning signals are used for faults of the camera/radar-based steering function, they shall be a continuous or intermittent sound signal or vocal information.
requirements.test_case: Induce a sensor fault and record that the acoustic warning is a continuous or intermittent tone or a voice message.

requirements.text: Where vocal information is employed as an acoustic warning, the alert shall use the language(s) of the market into which the vehicle is sold.
requirements.test_case: Check the voice-message language configuration against the target market.

requirements.text: Acoustic warning signals shall be easily recognized by the driver.
requirements.test_case: Subjective assessment in the vehicle under driving noise that the acoustic warning is clearly recognisable.

requirements.text: The means of verifying the correct operational status of the electronic steering system (e.g. warning signal) shall be protected against simple unauthorized modification, or a secondary means of checking the correct operational status shall be available.
requirements.test_case: Review the manufacturer's protection concept and attempt simple tampering (e.g. telltale manipulation) to confirm the status cannot be falsified.

requirements.text: In case of RCP, the parking manoeuvre shall be initiated by the driver but controlled by the system.
requirements.test_case: Perform an RCP manoeuvre and verify that it starts only on driver initiation and that the system then controls the manoeuvre.

requirements.text: In case of RCP, either a continuous actuation of the remote-control device by the driver or, for systems based on detection of driver position and motion, a continuous motion of the driver in the same longitudinal direction is required during the parking manoeuvre.
requirements.test_case: During an RCP manoeuvre, verify that the manoeuvre continues only while the remote-control device is continuously actuated or the driver moves continuously in the same longitudinal direction.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C that switches automatically to standby mode after an activation request on any type of road, the switch shall only occur when the system has verified that the road is of a valid type and not before the vehicle has reached a regular lane of travel.
requirements.test_case: Request activation on a non-valid road and on a slip road, and verify that standby mode is entered only once a valid road type is confirmed and the vehicle is in a regular lane.

requirements.text: In case of an ACSF of Category C, the system shall provide a means of detecting that the driver is holding the steering control.
requirements.test_case: Perform the lane change procedure with hands on and hands off the steering control and verify that the system detects each state correctly.

requirements.text: In case the camera and/or radar module form part of 'The System', the safety approach at concept (vehicle) level shall consider interactions of 'The System' with other vehicle systems (e.g. ACC/collision warning functions sharing the same sensors).
requirements.test_case: Review the hazard/risk analysis for coverage of interactions with other vehicle systems, with spot checks of selected items.

requirements.text: In case the camera and/or radar module form part of 'The System', the safety approach at concept (vehicle) level shall consider malfunctions of 'The System' within the scope of UN R79.
requirements.test_case: Review the concept-level hazard/risk analysis for coverage of sensor and system malfunctions.

requirements.text: The camera/radar unit supplied with a given identification shall conform to the corresponding documentation of 'The System'.
requirements.test_case: Compare the marked hardware/software version of production modules against the approved documentation.

requirements.text: In case the front sensors contribute to an ACSF of Category C, the ACSF Category C requirements shall be fulfilled for the whole speed range.
requirements.test_case: Review the manufacturer's documentation and test data covering the full Vsmin–Vsmax range and compare them with the Annex 8 test results.

requirements.text: In case of ACSF Category B1, the transition (hands-on) warning and deactivation requirements shall be fulfilled for the whole speed range of the system.
requirements.test_case: Run hands-off release tests at low and high speeds and review documentation covering the intermediate speeds.

requirements.text: In case of ACSF Category C, the sensor blindness detection, driver warning and lane change prevention requirements of paragraph 5.6.4.8.4 shall also be fulfilled under different driving scenarios.
requirements.test_case: Review the manufacturer's documentation and spot-check sensor blinding in additional driving scenarios.

requirements.text: In case of ACSF Category C, after a new powertrain initiation, the system shall detect a vehicle approaching from the rear in the adjacent lane no later than at the manufacturer-declared distance Srear.
requirements.test_case: Measure the detection distance of the approaching vehicle with DGPS during test phase 3 and compare it with Srear.
